Election Results 

2026 Primary Election




 

 
 
June 2, 2026
 Primary Election 
 

 The Primary Election is an election to determine which candidates will qualify for the General Election for a given party. In Iowa you must be a member of the political party of which you wish to vote for in order to participate. This is known as a "closed primary." The primary election is held on the 1st Tuesday following the 1st Monday in June of each even-numbered year. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
Archived Election Details 
 

 
Dates & Deadlines 
 

               Federal & State Candidates: Must file with Secretary of State Office in Des Moines 
 
 
 
Federal & State Candidate Filing Starts – February 23, 2026 
 
Federal & State Candidate Filing Deadline – March 13, 2026 
 
 

               County Candidates: 
 
 
 
County Candidate Filing Starts – March 2, 2026 
 
1st day to submit Absentee Ballot Request Form – March 24, 2026 
 
County Candidate Filing Deadline – March 20, 2026 
 
Absentee Ballots Ready to be Mailed – May 13, 2026 
 
Voter Pre-Registration Deadline – May 18, 2026 
 
Last Day Auditor's office can mail out Absentee Ballots – May 18, 2026

Absentee Voting In-Person:  
 

Available at the Auditor's Office from May 13, 2026 to June 1, 2026,
 
8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., with extended hours on: 
 
 
 
Monday, May 18, 2026: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (Voter Pre-Registration Deadline) 
 
Friday, May 29, 2026: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (Absentee Affidavits Review Deadline) 
 
Saturday, May 30, 2026: 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. (Early Voting Opportunity) 
 
 

Polling Hours 
 

7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. 
 

Candidate Information 
 
 
 
2026 Primary Candidate List 
 
 

Important Information 
 
 
 
Voter ID will be required on Election Day.  Voters going to the polls on Election Day will be required to provide ID in order to cast a regular ballot. 
 
Effective October 1, 2019, voters are required to provide either their driver's license or non operator's ID number or their four digit voter PIN when requesting an absentee ballot be mailed to them or when voting absentee at the courthouse.
